title: Micro Center store stock and prices

mode.title: Operation
mode.description: Search keywords, scan a category, or look up exact product IDs.

query.title: Search keywords
query.description: Used in search mode. Results are global catalog candidates, verified separately at your stores.

categoryId.title: Category ID
categoryId.description: Required in category mode. Filaments/resins754, graphics cards518, desktop computers106.

productIds.title: Product IDs
productIds.description: Required in product mode. Numeric product IDs, not store SKUs. Up to1000.

storeIds.title: Store IDs
storeIds.description: Select1–4 stores. Santa Clara195; Tustin101; Miami185. One row per product/store.

maxProducts.title: Maximum candidate products
maxProducts.description: Limits unique products to examine before store filtering; requests are sequential.

maxResults.title: Maximum output rows
maxResults.description: Stops after this many product/store observations are saved.

includeOutOfStock.title: Include out-of-stock observations
includeOutOfStock.description: False filters unavailable rows. Excluded rows still require upstream requests but do not create billable dataset items.

includeRaw.title: Include raw product fields
includeRaw.description: Adds vendor specs, ratings aggregates and other raw metadata. No numerical quantities or review bodies are provided.

startPage.title: Starting catalog page
startPage.description: Advanced: global candidate pagination,200 products per page. Starting after page1 is a partial catalog window.
